profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer II at Human Interest
profile.summary:
12 years experienced with software engineering, 5 years in Engineering Manager role.
 - Proven track-record in engineering leadership, hiring and coaching engineer team, successfully mentored people to leadership roles.
 - Experienced in building & operating high scale distributed services for critical business such as Amazon retail.
 - Proficient in working with cross-functional such as Product Manager, TPM, built and supported core products for Retail such as Cart, Checkout, both UX and services
 - Computer Science background, top 5% graduates in university

positions.title: Software Development Manager III
positions.description:
Transitioned from SDE2 to eventually managed 9 engineers at core Shopping Cart team. 
The group owned Amazon worldwide Shopping Cart page and CartAPI.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Build low latency FX trading platform built on top of Java, Spring, Java Swing supporting multiple trade types: Limit, Market, Stop Loss, If Done, Forward, Swap, etc...
- Develop FX order management and account management: account authorization, authentication, margin, limit.
- Develop cash management to manage user's balance (withdraw, deposit), Profit and Loss, trade commission and trade settlement using microservices with Scala, Spray, Akka, PostgresSQL.
- Develop price alert system allow user to get notification through email or sms when market price hit placed price target.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- DataESP is a startup company doing data analytics and business intelligence.
 - Build a web-based platform for clients to upload their data, run analytics and view analytics result.
 - Pioneered web solutions, tools, platform, prototype with modern programming technologies and web frameworks. Make decisions on the full web service stack (front end, web server and database). Design RESTful API between microservices.
 - Set up Continuous Integration and automatic deployment. Setup automated build & test.
Technology used: J2SE, Spring, RESTful service, Javascript, NodeJS, MongoDB, Redis, Amazon S3, Amazon EC2, Continous Integration, Design Patterns.

positions.title: Software Engineer 2
positions.description:
Hired as top 5 out of over 400 applicants from NTU students for an accelerated career track.

Resolve site live issues, fix live data inconsistency. Work on many projects to migrate old C++ stack to Java RESTful service oriented architecture. Develop rules for transaction limits (sending, receiving, withdraw, etc.), user onboarding checks on PayPal Credit.

Speaker in a short training on Hadoop and MapReduce for developer collegues in Singapore.

Acquired skills in Java, Spring, Maven, RESTful Java JAX-RS, Git/GitHub, Agile methodology.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research on Campus - Research Student
positions.description:
Research on a Cloud Computing system that augments games running on mobile devices by off-loading execution from mobile devices to the cloud infrastructure.

Research on how Hadoop distribute data between nodes in the cluster, how MapReduce schedule tasks in Map and Reduce phase when data is not evenly distributed. Resilience of the cluster in service break down scenario.

Skills learned are Android, Google App Engine Cloud, Hadoop and MapReduce.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research on Campus - Research Student
positions.description:
Designed and developed a wireless activity monitoring system for monkey behavioral study. The hardware system included micro-controller, sensors (accelerometer & gyroscope), GPS and battery. 

Acquired skills in embedded system design and programming, Assembly and Assembly C programming, ability to work independently, project management skill and problem-solving skills. Published a paper to IEEE International Symposium on Consumer Electronics 2011.

educations.schoolName: Ly Tu Trong High School for the Gifted

honors.title: Third prize in NTU Ventures Hackathon
honors.description: A 24-hours coding competition to produce a prototype of an idea that has commercialize potential.

honors.title: Dean’s list Award for excellent academic results
honors.description: Being a First Class Honour student and top 5% of the cohort.
honors.issuer: Issued by School of Computer Engineering, NTU · Jan 2009

projects.title: Remote and automatic heart rate measurement (24hr Hackathon, third prize)
projects.description:
An implementation of a MIT paper on the subject
Was in charge of pulling processed inputs from an input stream (e.g. video, or webcam live stream)
Worked hard to put the program together in 24hrs
Gave a presentation and live demo
